entities.summary: Ban Zhao (b. 45 CE, Eastern Han) was a political leader or statesperson of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Eastern Han. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers. He was the chief eunuch of the imperial court and served as a member of the imperial council.
